page: Alibaba Cloud ecs.c8a.32xlarge is a compute-optimized virtual server based on x86_64 architecture. It is powered by AMD EPYC 9T24 processors operating at a clock speed of 2.7 GHz, delivering 128 dedicated vCPUs. System memory totals 256 GB, resulting in a compute-focused ratio of 2.0 GB per vCPU. The instance runs on KVM hypervisor infrastructure.

Networking capabilities include a baseline bandwidth of 40 Gbps with no complimentary public IPv4 addresses included. The instance does not feature local disk storage, depending on network-attached block storage for operating system and data retention needs. Hardware accelerators are omitted, with zero GPUs onboard.

By allocating a high number of vCPUs per node with moderate memory capacity, the instance offers strong compute density for processing workloads that require substantial parallel vCPU performance without high memory overhead. Recommended deployments include batch processing, distributed build environments, ETL data pipelines, high-concurrency web servers, and compute-bound simulation tasks.
description: Alibaba Cloud ecs.c8a.32xlarge is a compute-optimized x86_64 instance featuring 128 dedicated vCPUs powered by AMD EPYC 9T24 processors operating at a clock speed of 2.7 GHz. Configured with 256 GB of system memory, the node maintains a strict 1:2 vCPU-to-RAM ratio providing 2.0 GB of RAM per core. The server offers a baseline network bandwidth of 40 Gbps under a KVM hypervisor architecture. No local storage is bundled with the instance, requiring external block storage for persistent data, and hardware acceleration is omitted with zero discrete GPUs present. The high concentration of dedicated vCPUs relative to memory provides an efficient resource footprint for CPU-bound tasks. The ecs.c8a.32xlarge is suited for parallelized compute applications, continuous integration pipelines, batch data processing, high-throughput web serving, and ETL tasks that leverage remote storage.
